scenes.line1: Why do end-to-end tests go flaky?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why end-to-end tests sometimes fail for no clear reason? What makes them so unreliable?

scenes.label: Scope
scenes.sub: Simulate real user flows across the whole system.
scenes.say: End-to-end tests cover the full user journey, checking how everything works together.
Flaky tests usually happen because of timing issues, unreliable networks, or external systems that aren't always available.
Here's a Cypress test that sometimes fails if the API responds slowly. That’s classic flakiness.

scenes.question: How do you fix flaky E2E tests?
scenes.right: Control test data, minimize dependencies, and use retries only when needed.
scenes.say: Interviewers want more than just adding retries. You should control your test data, reduce dependencies, and use retries carefully.
